summary: Anfield Energy filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 15, 2026 press release announcing that subsidiary Highbury Resources received a Colorado DRMS completeness determination and staff recommendation for approval of the JD-8 uranium-vanadium mine reclamation permit (File No. M-2025-056), with a Board hearing set for October 14-15, 2026. This is a routine operational permitting update, not a special situation. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed. Watch the October MLRB decision for permitting risk-arb relevance to the targeted Q2 2027 restart.
